name: Petha (Agra Style)
instructions: 1. Peel and deseed the ash gourd, cutting it into uniform cubes.
2. Prick the cubes thoroughly with a fork to allow syrup absorption.
3. Soak the cubes in a solution of water and slaked lime for 2-3 hours to firm the texture, then rinse thoroughly under running water.
4. Boil the cubes in plain water until they become translucent and tender.
5. Prepare a thick sugar syrup (one-string consistency) in a large pan.
6. Add the boiled cubes to the syrup and cook on low heat until the sugar crystallizes around the pieces.
7. Stir in rose water and cardamom powder, then set aside on a wire rack to cool and dry completely.
description: Agra Petha is a world-famous translucent soft candy from the Mughal-era city of Agra. It is iconic for its unique chewy texture and pristine sweetness, deeply rooted in the local culinary history of Uttar Pradesh and often considered a signature souvenir of the Taj Mahal city.
